title: Vidlunnia
profTagline: Your voice, any language: record ten seconds, type a line, hear yourself say it.
installDesc: Works offline, opens like an app
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: In the browser menu choose Install or Add to Home screen.
quiet: Too quiet. Speak closer to the phone
clipped: Too loud. Hold the phone a little further
short: Too short. Speak for a few seconds
micReason: Ten seconds of you become the voice that says what you type
micPrivacy: The take is sent only when you tap Say it, to make the echo
styleOff: A style applies to a clone only: pick Mine, Her or Him
noEchoesHint: Say it, and the result stays here
eNetwork: No connection. Try again when you are online
eRate: Too many requests. Wait a minute
eBusy: Every GPU is taken. Try again in a minute
eTimeout: The voice took too long. Try again
eFailed: Nothing came back. Try other words
eBig: The take is too long. Record a shorter one
eSignIn: Sign in to make an echo
chd_patrick: Slow, sleepy and a little dim
chd_bugs-bunny: Nasal, cocky and chewing a carrot
chd_darth-vader: Deep, heavy and breathing through a mask
chd_yoda: Old, croaky and wise, speaks backwards
chd_groot: Deep, wooden and three words only
chd_elsa: Clear, cool and about to sing
chd_pikachu: Tiny, sparky and squeaking its name
chd_baba-yaga: Old, cackling and creaky as her hut
